name: justanotherspy
description: Central marketplace for justanotherspy's Claude Code plugins, each sourced from its home repo.

plugins.name: shuck
plugins.description: Keep Claude current on the pull request you are actually working on. A background monitor follows your working tree and reports new CI failures with their exact failing step logs, review comments with the surrounding code, and GitHub Actions whose SHA pin has gone stale, as they happen. Adds the /shuck skill for the same reports on demand. Requires the shuck binary on PATH.

plugins.name: garlic
plugins.description: Ward off AI burnout: tracks active Claude Code time via hooks and nudges you to take breaks, plus a /garlic status command. Requires the garlic binary on PATH (cargo install garlic-ward).

plugins.name: sproot
plugins.description: Convert setup bash scripts into sproot.yaml modules, and author, explain and validate sproot configs - the /sproot:script-convert and /sproot:author-config skills.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Rewrite AI-sounding text so it reads naturally without changing what it says. External plugin maintained by blader, sourced from blader/humanizer.

plugins.name: output-styles
plugins.description: A collection of output styles for Claude Code. Includes ASD-STE100, Simplified Technical English for agent prose: one meaning per word, active voice, simple tenses, short sentences.
